entities.name: POP5 (Q54EP3)
observations: The 171-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt Q54EP3 from Dictyostelium discoideum.
POP5 is a component of RNase P and, by similarity, RNase MRP; RNase P processes tRNA 5′ leaders.
The query contains Pfam domain RNase_P_Rpp14 (PF01900.25), residues 7–111.
Reported sequence estimates: molecular mass 19,915 Da; pI 5.19; GRAVY −0.6175.
